basics.name: Oscar Olivera
basics.label: Software Developer · Games & Interactive Apps
basics.summary: Developer with more than 12 years of experience building interactive software: an open-source typing game for children, a streaming app for set-top boxes driven by remote-control focus, real-time WebRTC calling, and a football prediction pool on Ethereum. I enjoy making software that people want to come back to.

work.name: e-Matrix Innovations
work.summary: Platform for enterprises, factories, and other organizations to create training programs for technical staff, track employee progress through learning paths, document required certifications, analyze training effectiveness, and streamline onboarding.
highlights: Built tracking for learner and employer enrollments, including automatic re-enrollment when courses change or renew.

Designed and built a new application architecture to replace a legacy system with significant technical debt. Rebuilt rather than patched, because the architectural problems could not be fixed incrementally.

work.name: The RealReal
work.summary: Member of the Outbound team, about nine people including the Product Owner, Project Manager, QA, and developers based in Brazil, Canada, and Mexico.
highlights: Built and maintained Elixir/Phoenix microservices that consumed operations queued through Kafka and communicated with a Ruby on Rails monolith.

work.name: Super.mx
work.summary: Joined as the second full-time engineer and worked on the monolithic Elixir application. The team had no fixed hierarchy, and everyone worked at a senior level.
highlights: Built the COVID and life insurance purchase flows, then released the life product using LiveView as a multi-step flow.
Built reusable flows for life, quake, COVID, and home insurance, including A/B test variants.

work.name: Resuelve
work.summary: Worked on a team that chose Elixir for most projects built from scratch.
highlights: Built experimental projects, including an employee management system (attendance, permissions, surveys, payroll) and a football prediction pool as an Ethereum smart contract.
Led a team building a WebRTC/SIP client, managing issue delegation, stakeholder collaboration, and PR review.
keywords: WebRTC/SIP client (SIP.js) with an Elixir backend

work.name: Global Hitss
highlights: Led the redesign and maintenance of the Clarovideo streaming app for Android mobile and set-top boxes.
Led the redesign that changed the interface and improved performance, including replacing ListView with RecyclerView and prefetching API requests based on user focus.
Upgraded the mobile player to support DASH alongside HLS.
Involved in ClaroMúsica web player events using React/Redux.
Managed six developers by delegating tickets and providing technical guidance.

projects.name: TypingSnail
projects.description: Open-source typing game that helps children learn to type: type each letter before the bike splashes the snails.
highlights: 64 levels in 6 worlds, from a single key to fast, mistake-free typing.
Difficulty adapts to each child and is saved between sessions.
Cartoon art drawn with the HTML canvas, sound effects synthesized with Web Audio, and spoken letter names.
Deployed to GitHub Pages with GitHub Actions.
